# Widget `concept-map` — Concept map

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use to show how 3–14 key ideas relate to each other through labelled links.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "concept-map",
  "title": "Concept map",
  "props": {
    "nodes": [
      {
        "id": "supply",
        "label": "Supply"
      },
      {
        "id": "demand",
        "label": "Demand"
      },
      {
        "id": "price",
        "label": "Price"
      }
    ],
    "links": [
      {
        "from": "demand",
        "to": "price",
        "label": "raises"
      },
      {
        "from": "supply",
        "to": "price",
        "label": "lowers"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | array of object (3–14) | yes |
| `nodes[].id` | string | yes |
| `nodes[].label` | string | yes |
| `links` | array of object (0–30) | yes |
| `links[].from` | string | yes |
| `links[].to` | string | yes |
| `links[].label` | string | yes |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
